about: One origin of one width is worth what it connects: nothing inside a city where every pair already had a walk, one pair between two lone cells, and the product of two components when it lands across a desert.
The same claim, the same cost, four placements and four prices, so where to look is a question with an answer.
What it crosses is named before it lands.

cases.name: one origin placed four ways in the two-city world
